Finland President Stubb: Russia unlikely to attack NATO

Finnish President Alexander Stubb stated in an interview with Die Welt that Russia is unlikely to risk a direct military attack on a NATO member. He noted that while Russia's actions in Ukraine are concerning, an attack on NATO territory would be a significant escalation. Stubb also mentioned that NATO's increased presence and activities in the Arctic region are perceived by Russia as a direct threat, according to Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov.
